pr_title: ADR 0123: complete Stateful Behavior Tree first release
pr_body:
## Summary

- preserve the already-complete stateful Behavior Tree executor, compiled graph, runtime snapshot, and authoring contracts
- add read-only transient selected-node runtime details without mutating Graph or GraphView selection
- close visual acceptance with deterministic Running, Success, Failure, abort/reset, elapsed-time, palette, graph, and detail evidence
- keep Editor, CLI, and MCP authoring on the shared BehaviorTreeAuthoringService/schema registry and mark ADR 0123 Accepted

## Validation

Run affected Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation.
